About This Game

A trick-taking card game designed specifically for two players. Special powers on every card, and winning too many tricks is just as dangerous as winning too few.

Why we picked it: Under $15, plays in 20 minutes, and the 'avoid winning' mechanic is brilliant.

How to Play

Fox in the Forest plays with 2 players and takes about 20 minutes. It is recommended for ages 10+ with a complexity rating of 1.9 out of 5.

The goal depends on the game type. 2-Player Games games focus on head-to-head games designed specifically for two. great for couples.. Each round pushes players to make decisions, adapt to the board state, and outplay their opponents.

Setup is straightforward. The rulebook is designed to get you playing fast, not reading for 30 minutes. Most groups understand the flow within the first round.

What Makes It Fun

The best part of Fox in the Forest is how it creates moments. Every session has a story. A comeback win. A close call. A move that made everyone at the table react.

It balances luck and skill. New players can win. Experienced players can consistently do well. That balance keeps the game coming back to the table.

Who Is It For

This game works best for groups that enjoy 2-player games. If you like thinking on your feet, reading the table, and games that change every time, Fox in the Forest is a solid pick.

It works for both casual players and experienced gamers. The rules are light enough for beginners but the decisions are deep enough for veterans.
